skills.skill_desc:
Enemies hit by Sun or his Doppelgangers will have their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 15% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage.
Sun or his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 65 extra damage to creeps.

Sun hurls his <font color="a6aafb">Golden Staff</font> in the target direction, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path.
Upon hitting an enemy hero or creep, or upon reaching maximum range, the <font color="a6aafb">Golden Staff</font> transforms into a <font color="a6aafb">Doppelganger</font> that pursues enemies. The <font color="a6aafb">Doppelganger</font> inherits Sun's attributes, deals 60% of Sun's damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s.
This skill shares its level and cooldown with <font color="a6aafb">Swift Exchange</font>.

Sun hurls his <font color="a6aafb">Golden Staff</font> in the target direction, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path.

He conjures a <font color="a6aafb">Doppelganger</font> at his location that inherits his attributes, deals 60% damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s.
Sun transforms into the <font color="a6aafb">Golden Staff</font> and becomes concealed, reappearing at its maximum range.

Sun commands his Doppelgangers to strike at the target enemy with him, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing the target and enemies behind them by 25% (can be stacked) for 1.5s. This counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger Attack Effects but cannot Crit.
Sun summons a <font color="a6aafb">Doppelganger</font> that inherits his attributes, deals 80% damage, and takes 120% damage for 8s.
